chemistry.notes: Estimated: Standard Range is LFP since 2023/2024 (InsideEVs); the Ford 2025 sheet shows the 108-cell SR pack unchanged.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Ford 2025 spec sheet lists SR RWD and SR eAWD at 73 kWh usable (108 LFP-pack cells); same hardware carried to 2026 (2025 vs 2026 compared; nothing shows a change). Replaces the imported OpenEV / Chargeprice figures (70 and 91 kWh).

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: Electrek reports 78.21 kWh total for the 2023 LFP SR pack (108 cells, Ford presentation); the 2025 sheet lists the same 108-cell SR pack. Replaces the imported OpenEV 75.7 kWh (the older NMC pack).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Ford 2025 spec sheet: up to 150 kW DC fast charge (all trims); same hardware carried to 2026.
